messages:
maya_customer: Hey team, seeing inconsistent answers from the API after yesterday's rollout. Same prompt sometimes returns a short bullet list, other times a long paragraph with extra hallucinated facts. This started at ~2026-03-15T16:12:00Z. Request ids: r_qpY2, r_qpY9, r_qpZ0. Sample input and outputs attached below.

alex_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste one of the request payloads and the full response for r_qpY2? Also, do you have a pinned model version in your tenant config or are you relying on routing?

maya_customer: Payload: `{
  "model": "redwood-instruct-latest",
  "prompt": "Summarize the policy update in 3 bullets",
  "max_tokens": 150,
  "temperature": 0.0
}`
Response A (short bullets): `- Updated retention: 90 days
- New access logging
- Clarified sharing policy`
Response B (long, hallucinated): `Policy updated to include mandatory encryption with AcmeKMS and quarterly audits by ZetaCorp. Also deprecates legacy API v1.`

alex_support: That definitely looks like two different model behaviors. Do you see any change in the model or variant specified in the response headers? Can you share `x-redwood-model` and `x-redwood-variant` from the responses?

maya_customer: Headers for r_qpY2: `x-redwood-model: redwood-instruct-latest; x-redwood-variant: instruct-v1.3`. For r_qpZ0: `x-redwood-model: redwood-instruct-latest; x-redwood-variant: instruct-v1.3-quant`. We didn't change anything on our side.

alex_support: Thanks — that matches the hypothesis. Looks like routing/fallback sent some requests to the quantized variant which may diverge on deterministic outputs (even at temp=0). I'm escalating to runtime eng. @sam_eng-runtime can you take a look?

sam_eng-runtime: saw the escalation, pulling traces now. Deploy-bot shows a routing policy tweak rolled at 2026-03-15T16:10:21 that added `allow_fallback:true` for the instruct family to reduce tail latency during pressure. That would allow switching between instruct-v1.3 and instruct-v1.3-quant.

luis_oncall: Noted. If fallback is mixing variants mid-session, that's a regression for deterministic workloads. We should check if KV cache is compatible across variants. If not, mixing will produce divergent outputs.

sam_eng-runtime: Reproduced locally: with routing fallback enabled, 30% of requests hit quant variant under simulated capacity conditions and outputs differ for exact same prompt. KV cache keying was shared; we need explicit variant-scoped KV or disallow cross-variant cache reuse.

alex_support: For a mitigation for the customer: Maya, two immediate options — 1) pin `model_variant: instruct-v1.3` in your tenant config to force strict routing, or 2) set `routing.allow_fallback=false` for your project until we fix this. Which do you prefer?

maya_customer: We'll pin variant for now. How do we set that?

alex_support: Add to your project config UI or config API: `{ "routing": { "model_variant": "instruct-v1.3", "allow_fallback": false } }`. After you set it, send a couple of sample request ids and we'll verify responses stabilize.

maya_customer: Done. Sent r_qpY9 after pin — headers show `x-redwood-variant: instruct-v1.3` and response matches the short bullets. Looks stable so far, thanks.

sam_eng-runtime: Next steps from runtime: rollback the `allow_fallback:true` quick change and prepare a variant compatibility patch that ensures per-variant KV namespaces. Will open a PR and a canary deploy.

luis_oncall: I'm scheduling a short maintenance window to revert the policy at 2026-03-16T02:00Z UTC. Will monitor for regressions.

sam_eng-runtime: Filed issue INF-9832 "Prevent cross-variant cache reuse -> inconsistent outputs" and assigned to runtime team. Patch will add variant-scoped cache keys and also add a check in routing: if model variants differ in quantization/profile, do not fallback by default for deterministic customers.

alex_support: I'll follow up with Maya once we have a timeline. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: routing-policy-update rolled back (id: rp-9921) by luis_oncall at 2026-03-16T02:01:12Z.

sam_eng-runtime: Confirming rollback in prod; running continuous checks against the sample prompts to verify output consistency.

maya_customer: Appreciate the fast response. Will keep monitoring and will reopen if anything else shows up.

alex_support: Closing the support ticket after verification; feel free to ping us if anything else pops up.
